capabilities: Filter the file explorer into curated or folder-pinned spaces
Collect notes into a space by tag or property
Reorder rows within each space by dragging
Restore each space's own tabs when switching
disambiguation: Not a workspace layout manager; it filters what the file explorer shows instead of saving and restoring pane layouts.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true), requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later, must be built from source before installing, and the README states it makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: Only what the explorer shows changes. All is Obsidian's own tree, untouched.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer always shows the whole vault, so there is no way to scope the visible tree to one piece of work without moving files or saving pane layouts.
summary: Adds spaces to the file explorer: curated or folder-pinned filtered views of vault notes and folders, switchable without moving any files.
